name: Google DeepMind: AGI Safety Short Course
old_details: A free, self-paced introductory course on AGI safety from Google DeepMind's safety research team, consisting of ~75 minutes of short recorded talks and exercises with an accompanying slide deck and exercise workbook. The course mentions research scientist and research engineer role applications open until Feb 28, but this is separate from the course itself.

name: Outsider's Roadmap to AI Safety (LessWrong)
old_details: A comprehensive guide written in July 2025 for professionals transitioning into AI safety research from technical fields. Covers three main domains: interpretability research (reverse-engineering AI systems), alignment research (ensuring AI systems remain beneficial and share human values), and AI control & governance (technical policy for advanced systems). Synthesizes insights from Neel Nanda's mechanistic interpretability resources, 80,000 Hours career research, and the broader alignment community, with practical advice on roles (research engineers vs. scientists converging into 'full-stack researchers'), required skills, and how newcomers can contribute to the field.
